mapper.select: order by "requestedAt" desc nulls last, "batchId" desc limit #{criteria.safeSize} offset #{criteria.offset}

select ebr.batch_id as "batchId", coalesce(error_item ->> 'targetKey', error_item ->> 'sourceAchievementId', error_item ->> 'targetId', '-') as "targetKey", coalesce(error_item ->> 'targetName', error_item ->> 'achievementTitle', '-') as "targetName", coalesce(error_item ->> 'errorCode', 'BATCH_ITEM_ERROR') as "errorCode", coalesce(error_item ->> 'message', error_item ->> 'errorMessage', '-') as "message", coalesce(error_item ->> 'detail', error_item::text) as "detail" from evaluation_batch_results ebr cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(ebr.error_detail_json) as error_item where ebr.batch_id = #{batchId} order by "targetKey" limit #{size} offset #{offset}
select count(*) from evaluation_batch_results ebr cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(ebr.error_detail_json) as error_item where ebr.batch_id = #{batchId}
